verdict.rationale: Devin offers building blocks for a team-wide source of truth — repo indexing that powers 'Ask Devin' and DeepWiki architecture docs, org-wide 'Knowledge' referenced in all sessions, and AGENTS.md support for shared context — which collectively let a lead centralize docs/repo knowledge for the team. However, there's no explicit product feature framed as a 'shared workspace' UI for team-wide docs/repo browsing outside of Devin's own agent sessions. Missing for 10: a dedicated shared workspace/knowledge-base product surface for humans to browse, independent evidence of teams using it as a collaborative source of truth, and clarity on cross-repo doc aggregation beyond per-session knowledge.
